However, the overall value-back is quite dependent on the spending capacity of the cardholder as many of these features come with spend-based conditions.

faqs.q: How can I track my ICICI credit card status?
faqs.a: You can check the application status of your ICICI Bank Rubyx credit card by either visiting the official bank website or by calling teh credit card customer care number.

faqs.q: Will I be charged any fee on making international purchases using the ICICI Bank Rubyx credit card?
faqs.a: Yes, a forex markup fee of 3.50% will be charged on all international retail and online transactions. It will also be applied when the card is used at those POS machines which are registered in the international territory; like the POS machines at duty-free shops.

faqs.q: What are the criteria to avail the complimentary access to domestic airport lounges?
faqs.a: In order to avail the free domestic airport lounge access, you must spend at least Rs. 75,000 during the previous calendar quarter.

faqs.q: What is the age eligibility criteria to apply for ICICI Rubyx Credit Card?
faqs.a: The applicant must be between the ages of 21 and 65 years to be eligible for applying for ICICI Bank Rubyx Credit Card.

faqs.question: Is the ICICI Bank Rubyx Credit Card lifetime free?
faqs.answer: Not usually. The joining fee is ₹3,000 + GST and the annual fee is ₹2,000 + GST, though ICICI sometimes offers it free to existing customers. The annual fee is waived when you spend ₹3 lakh in a year.

faqs.question: What is the forex markup on the ICICI Bank Rubyx Credit Card?
faqs.answer: It's 3.5% plus GST on spends in a foreign currency. That's the usual rate, so it isn't the best card to use abroad.

faqs.question: Does the ICICI Bank Rubyx Credit Card give airport lounge access?
faqs.answer: Yes. You get 2 domestic visits a quarter once you spend ₹75,000 in the previous quarter.

faqs.question: How much can I earn with the ICICI Bank Rubyx Credit Card?
faqs.answer: You earn about 0.25% back in reward points on regular spends, and up to 1% on its bonus categories. Check the review above for the exact categories and monthly caps.
